primary_task: Check a service's codebase for GDPR risks by running scripts/gdpr_compliance_checker.py and reporting the compliance score, risk categories and prioritized recommendations.

requirements.name: python
requirements.basis: bash: "run shell commands on Linux x86_64: ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts" (Python is standard on Linux; also obtainable from Ubuntu apt)

requirements.name: read
requirements.basis: read: "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)"

notes: The scripts are bundled with the skill and run locally; no external host or credential is named. DPIA generation and DSAR tracking also only run local Python scripts. 'Send response' in Workflow 2 and 'Register DPO with supervisory authority' in Workflow 3 are human actions outside the primary task. No unknown statuses.
